śambhunirṇayadīpikā ।। (śivānandanāthaviracitā)
śrīḥ
(p.132) dharākṣīrabṛhadbhānusamīravyomamānase । vyāpakaṃ paramodāraṃ saṃvidrūpaṃ śivaṃ bhaje ।।
ajeśaprabhupātreṇa pratiṣṭhānandasūnunā । laghvī vyākhyā mateśasya śivānandena likhyate ।।
sarvānugrāhakaṃ śambhuṃ tantraṃ sarvāvabhāsakam । sarvādhikārasaṃsiddhyai bahavātārayatprabhuḥ ।।
kriyottarāṇi śāstrāṇi tathā jñānottarāṇi ca । vyāmiśrāṇi bahūnyekaśśambhuḥ kathitavān vibhuḥ ।।
mahāmataṃ lakṣamataṃ mateśānamate iti । evamādyākhyayā śāstraṃ mahattena prakāśitam ।।
tasya śāstrasya vistṛtyā kṛpottaratayā punaḥ । śrīśāsanaṃ sahasrāryaṃ saṅgṛhītaṃ śivena tat ।।
śrīśambhunirṇayo devo mateśa iti cākhyayā । prasṛtaṃ bhuvaneṣveṣu bhāskarasya prabhā yathā ।।
śambhureva svayaṃ sākṣācchrīcaryānāthasaṃjñayā । śāstraṃ prakāśayan bhūmau mahāgurupade sthitaḥ ।।
tatsantāne sthitaḥ śrīmān pratiṣṭhānandasaṃjñayā । (p.133) yogī kaścinmaheśāno guruḥ puṇyaikavigrahaḥ ।।
śivānandamuniryogī śivacintāparassadā । svapne tañca guruṃ dṛṣṭvā pratyakṣaṃ labdhavān punaḥ ।।
adhītya cācāryamukhācchāstraṃ vidyāpurassaram । gurūṇānyavasatpārśve śivānando mahāmuniḥ ।।
kālena mahatā soyaṃ gurubhiḥ karuṇottaraiḥ । sthāpitonugrahavidhau sābhiṣekaṃ sahānidham ।।
tatassampādayāmāsa śiṣyānācārabhūṣitān । deśakālaviśeṣajñā bhaktiratnamahodadhīn ।।
śivānandamuni * * śiṣyeṇācirasevinā । akarodarthito vyākhyāṃ cidānandena dhīmatā ।।
pratiṣṭhānandadugdhābdheśśivānandendurutthitāḥ । tanute śrīsahasrārdhavyākhyaṃ jyotsnāṃ bhuvastale ।।
gurusmṛtidaśābhaktisthālidhīsnehagarbhiṇī । spaṣṭā viracitā vyākhyā śambhunirṇayadīpikā ।।
śrotārotrāstrikā doṣo na teṣāṃ dṛṣṭigocaraḥ । śive doṣaprakāśasyādvyākhyātāro vayaṃ kila ।।
na hi kaścitprabandhosti viśvatrā doṣavāgiha । svātantryānavadhānābhyāṃ doṣaḥ syādyatra kutracit ।।
doṣamajñā na jānanti prājñāstaṃ śikṣayanti ca । (p.134) nāropayantyato doṣaṃ vyākhyātari tu kecana ।।
tatra śrīsahasrārdhaśāsanaṃ ṣaḍviṃśatyarthapratipādanaparaṃ tatsaṃkhyāvacchedātmakam । tatra prathamenāvacchedenārcāmaṇḍalakalpanamucyate । dvitīyenārcanasya paryāyaḥ । tṛtīyena naveśvarārcanam । caturthena dūtyarcanam । pañcamena nāveśva * ro homaḥ । ṣaṣṭhena rogasamūhārī । saptamena śrīvaibhavadhyānam । aṣṭamena śaktidhyānam । navamenaindavadhyānam । daśamena prābhākaradhyānam । ekādaśena bījaṣoḍhā । dvādaśena śrīsamayāśambaroddhāraḥ । trayodaśena kṣetreśaśambaroddhāraḥ । caturdaśena śrīsādhanam । pañcadaśena sarvasamīhitapradañcakram । ṣoḍaśena kumārikāveśaḥ । saptadaśena śrīkramasaparyā । aṣṭādaśena paramāṇūnāmarcanam । ekonaviṃśena mativikāsopāyaḥ । viṃśena śrīśikheśvarasādhanam । ekaviṃśena śrītadgrahanyāsaḥ । dvāviṃśena purakṣobhaḥ । trayoviṃśena mṛtyuñjayo yogaḥ । caturviṃśena pāralaukikasamutkrāntiḥ । pañcaviṃśena śarīrasiddhisādhanam । ṣaḍviṃśena śikhāyogaḥ । tadidaṃ divyaṃ śāsanaṃ dukhagāhamatigūḍhaṃ sampradāyaikagamyam । guruvaktrādyathāśrutaṃ vyākhyāyate ।
kuṇḍamaṇḍaladīkṣāṇukramārcāpūjakātmanā । svātantryeṇaiva yo bhāti sarvadā taṃ stumaśśivam ।।
svārājyetyāditassūtradvayamekavākyārtham । svārājyahāṭakeśānamujjīvanmuktisādhanam । yatastamavyayaṃ śambhuṃ natvāhaṃ syāddhimātmajā ।। (p.135) vyāsabhayāllaghusādhyāṃ pṛcchāmi tvāṃ jagatpate । saparyāṃ sarvacittecchādāyinīṃ śrīśivātmanaḥ ।।
svaśabdena svargavācinā dharmo lakṣyate । rājyaśabdenārthaḥ । hāṭakeśānaśabdena kāmaḥ । taduktam
asurīsambhṛtānantapūjanakrīḍanaiṣiṇā । kvacidbhagavatā tena hāṭakeśena pālitaḥ ।। iti ।
mṛjjīvanmuktirmṛtamuktijjīvanmuktiśca dharmādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ sādhanam । yataḥ syāttaṃ śambhuṃ bhavatirarthāttrāntīrṇanyarthaḥ । sukhasya bhāvayitāraṃ sādhakānām । akālakalitamanenopāsakānāma(pya)kālakalitatvaṃ sūcayati । uktañca-
jīvanneva vimuktosau yasyeyaṃ bhāvanā sadā । yaśśivaṃ bhāvayennityaṃ na kālaḥ kalayecca tam ।।
iti । himātmajā himavatputrī । vyāsabhayāllakṣamatādyuktavistārabhayāt । anuṣṭhātṝṇāṃ saukaryāyetyarthaḥ । laghusādhyāṃ saṅgrahasādhyām । ahaṃ tvāṃ pṛcchāmīti yojanā । jagatpate he viśvapālayitassaparyāṃ pūjām । sarvacittecchādāyinīm । sarvāsāṃ cittecchānandānāṃ dātrīṃ cittasya sarvecchādātrīmiti vā । rājyādimokṣaparyantavāñchā sarvecchā śrīśivātmanaḥ śrīniveśasya । hṛdayaṃ saptamyarthe hṛdaye viśvapratiṣṭhāsthāne cidātmani । taduktam
hṛdayaṃ tadvijānīyādviśvasyāyatanaṃ mahat । iti । (p.136) iti ।
hṛdaye cittasaṅghaṭṭāt dṛśyaṃ svādarśanam ।
iti ca । svānte dvitīyārthe svāntaṃ manaḥ । vikārāntargataṃ * * * * * * kāraṃ kṛtveti śeṣaḥ । kuru manastviti nidhāyāvadhānaṃ kurvityarthaḥ । dadhānīti madhyamasthāne dhehīti । nosmākaṃ vacaḥ hitamupadeśavacanaṃ svānte cetasi । santu te divyasiddhaya iti । tvāṃ viśvātmikāṃ nimittīkṛtya lokatrayopakārāya vayamupadiśāmaḥ । atastvāmupakarttuṃ pravṛtasya sādhakavaryasyāpramattasyāṇimādyā mokṣaparyantāssarvāssiddhayo bhavantvityarthaḥ । asyāṃ śambhunirṇayadīpikāyāṃ gurumukhācchrutapūrvamevārthaṃ kathayāmaḥ । gurupārśvavāsakleśaṃ sahamānairasmābhissādhitoyamarthaḥ । āgamavākyatvātsāmpradāyikopyartho bhūyān bhavati । purāpraveśanam । praveśanapūrvakaṃ kasya śakteḥ paramasvātantryarūpasyānugrahātmanaśśaktipātasya viśiṣṭalakṣaṇayuktassan sampradāyāt gurordīkṣāprāptipurassaramityarthaḥ । prāṇināṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇabhṛtāmuparīti śeṣaḥ । sarvathā prāṇaharaṇāvasthāyāmapi krudhāṃ krodhaṃ kuru । devārcāmiti samayādyavasthāṃ prāpya sarvatra śivabhāvanāṃ kurvannātmavadviśvaṃ paśyan śrīnaveśvarārcanāṃ kurvityarthaḥ । uktañca -
asti cedindriyākrāntiḥ kiṃ prāpyaṃ pūjyapūjanaiḥ । nāsti cedindriyākrāntiḥ kiṃ prāpyaṃ pūjyapūjanaiḥ ।।
iti । (p.137) mahākāruṇike śāstre dīkṣitaṃ prāṇinaṃ yadi । naro hanyāttadā tena hatāśśambhumarīcayaḥ ।।
iti ca । sarvasiddhirdharmādipañcakam । ājñātrayoditāṃ u(dhā)rakaraṇādi lakṣaṇacetovṛtirūpakevalabodhaikavigrahamātrāṇavaśāktaśāmbhavātmopāyatrayoditām । dīkṣāṃ śivatādānabhedapāśakṣapaṇalakṣaṇām । ādāya prāpya । gurustāṃ gṛṇāti tātvikamarthamupadiśati śiṣyasyeti । gurustasmātsvasyānubhavaparyantaṃ gurossakāśāddīkṣāṃ prāpyetyarthaḥ । kiñca । sābhiṣekāṃ sahābhiṣekavatīṃ sapatnīkāṃ sahadharmacāriṇīm । sahitām । tato bodhāvāptilakṣaṇasaṃskārānantaram । anuṣṭhānakaṃ bhajet । nityanaimittikaṃ karma vidhivatseveta । saroruhāsanaṃ padmāsanaṃ badhvā yajedityanvayaḥ । purastānādivigrahaḥ ādiśabdena sandhyopāsanādikaṃ lakṣyate । jñānasandhyopāsanādipūrvagātraḥ snānādinā viśuddhadeha ityarthaḥ । ukta(ñca) ।
sandhyāhīno'śucirnityamanarhassarvakarmasu ।
iti । viviktadeśaṃ paśudṛṣṭivarjitam । uktañca -
śuddhe manojñe paśudṛṣṭipātavivarjite devagṛhe gṛhe vā ।
iti । saṃsmṛtyeti । saḥ pūjakaḥ । prathamaṃ paraṃ sarvapūjakam । śāmbhavaṃ dhāma vittasamullāsaṃ sarvatassarvatra sphuratārūpam । ataśca kartṛjñātasvabhāvam । tejaḥ saṃsmṛtya paraṃ jyotiḥ paramaṃ jyotiḥ । kalārūpatayā sarvā devatāśca vimṛśyatāpām । ke śirasi sahetuṃ nidānena sahāke brahmarandhre tatparaṃ (p.138) dhāmoddeśena dattam । sakāraṇaṃ puṣpaṃ sambhojyam । rasagandhau । prakāraparamārthena parapramātari paramaśive cāveśyetyarthaḥ । ardhānnasalilaṃ ardhānnaṃ ardhasalilam । ardhaśabdaḥ pulliṃṅgaḥ । sahetuṃ vihitopetam । samantranetrapātena mantropetena dṛṣṭipātena muktakena uddhāraṃ vinā paṭhitena । alivarṇena ṣoḍaśavarṇena । sarvasiddhipradena pañcavargapradena mantreṇeti śeṣaḥ । bhūtādiveṣṭitaṃ bhūtayakṣarakṣakṣetrādhipatibhiḥ parivṛtam । asya sūtradvayasyāyaṃ vākyārthaḥ । annasalilahetupūrṇaṃ sādhāraṃ caṣakaṃ sthāpayitvā bhūtādiparivṛtaṃ dhyātvā dṛṣṭipātenāmuṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaraṃ mantraṃ tridhā japan । śāntibaliṃ dadyāditi । balimantramāha - oṃ hrīṃ sarvavighnakṛdbhayaḥ sarvabhūtebhyo hrūṃ svāhā । taśśāntibalividhānānantaram । svapurassvasyārcakasya purobhāge alaṃ maṇḍalaślokān pañcapraṇavān pañca । smin maṇḍale svarṇapaṭṭādikam । ādiśabdena rajatatāmrādikaṃ lakṣyate । saṃvarttikāmaṣṭadalaṃ padmam । navārcane naveśvarārcānimittam । gandhacandrārkaśvete śālilipte । gandhaḥ kastūrikā । candraścandanam । arkaḥ kuṅkumam । śveteśaḥ karpūram । aliḥ kāraṇam । hemanālayā svarṇasūcyā । alādhaḥ viracitagurumaṇḍalādadhobhāge । adhaśśabdassāmarthyāccaturaṅgulabahiṣkṛte caturthāṃśamānaṃ tanmaṇḍalaṃ turīyāṃśamānaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kuryāditi । pūrvaṃ kimarthaṃ sthāpanahetave sthāpanārtham । kasya nidānasya । arghyadravyasya devasānnidhyadāyinaḥ pūjyānāṃ kramadevatānāṃ sannidhīkaraṇapaṭīyasaḥ । uktañca -
yat * kānāṃ praṇayavacasi prauḍhimānaṃ vidhatte । (p.139) yannirvighnaṃ nidhuvanavidhau sādhvasaṃ sandhunoti ।। yasmin viśvākalita * * yo devatāścakracarya- stanmādhvīkaṃ sapadi kurute yatra bhogāpavargau ।।
iti । pradhānālakharadeśe kharo'griḥ । pradhānamaṇḍalasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge vedāṅgulabahiṣkṛte caturaṅgulabahiṣkṛte vedāṅgulavistṛtyā caturaṅgulaṃ maṇḍalaṃ daṇḍābhamāyāmataḥ dvāṣpaprapūjane dvārapālārcānimittam । taccandrāṃśe tasya maṇḍalasya । uttaradigbhāge tathaiva yathā dvārapālamaṇḍale vedāṅgulabahiṣkaraṇāyāmavistārāḥ । tathā śrīgurūṇāṃ maṇḍalaṃ syādityanvayaḥ । saṃvarttādiprabhogināṃ saṃvarttaḥ kṣayaḥ । ādiśabdena kṛ(te dvākā) lakṣyante । ete yugaguravaḥ । tattatkālāvacchedabhāginaḥ । tanmānāt pradhānamaṇḍalāt । ūrdhvata uparibhāge । urdhvaśabdassāmarthyāt caturaṅgulabahiṣkṛte paścāddivyagurumaṇḍalakaraṇāt puroditaiḥ puroktaiḥ pañcabhiḥ ślokaiḥ । pradhānoktamantrapīṭhayajamānāya pradhānena parameśvareṇa praṇītasya mantrapīṭhasyāgamasyārcāyai suhetunā adīkṣitahastāspṛṣṭena viśiṣṭena vā nidānena । uktamaṇḍalaparyante maṇḍalakaraṇāvasāne hetuyajanam । arghyamaṇḍalasthāpitātrāntargatasya hetoryajanamārabhet । kuryādityarthaḥ । paśuveśmoṣitāśuddhiśodhanāya śivasaṃskāravihīnavāstunivāsadoṣaparihṛtyai amṛtāya niśreyasāya ganetitribhirmaṇḍalaśuddhipurassaramarghyaśuddhividhānamāha । tatra pañcaratnānyāha - ganeti । gana ādyakṣaralopaḥ । gaganeti । sva antyavarṇalopaḥ । svargeti । keśo jaleśaḥ । (p.140) paścimabhāgaḥ somabhāgaḥ । yamo dakṣiṇabhāgaḥ । pūrvaḥ prāgbhāgaḥ । tattadbhābhāñji pañcaratnānītyarthaḥ । pañcaratnabījānyāha śivetyādi । śivā gakāraḥ । bhṛgussakāraḥ । kālo makāraḥ । raktaḥ pakāraḥ । meṣo nakāraḥ । dharā lakāraḥ । ṣaṣṭhasvara ūkāraḥ । tadalordhve tasya maṇḍalasyorddheva । tādṛgvidhāni pañcaratnāni maṇḍale yathā nihitāni tathārghyepīti sampradāyaḥ । glūṃ gaganaratnāya glūm । slūṃ svarggaratnāya slūm । mlūṃ marttyaratnāya mlūm । plūṃ pātālaratnāya plūm । nlūṃ nāgaratnāya nlūm । tataḥ pañcaratnanidhānānantaram । devyā niṣkalavidyayā daśākṣaryā । śrīnavena naveśvaramantreṇa । anena mantrasaṃskārasaṃskṛtena sarvaparidhvaṃsakāriṇā । dīkṣitasya saṃskṛtatvādeva darśanasparśanaprāśanaissarvapāpahāriṇaḥ । somasutaṃ somavadvedepi surācādhikṛte । tasya śuddhānanyasya । taduktam-
sautāmaṇyaṃ surā hotu * * * dvyādyasya viparyayam ।

navakamityādi । pañcakaṃ navakamityanvayaḥ । pañcamaṃ bhūbījam । tālābhaṃ haritālavaṇa(ma) - kanakālaye mūlādhāre । sabinduṃ bindusahitam । prāṇaparyāntasthitiḥ śvāsasthitiparyantā । yāvat sākalyena । mūlādhāre kanakavarṇe haritālavarṇakaṃ sabindukaṃ bhūbījarūpam । naveśam । niruddhaprāṇo dhyāyediti (vākyārthaḥ) hāyanārdhāt ṣaṇmāsāt baliṃ * * * * * * * * * yogīśvaraḥ yogināmīśvaraḥ uttamaḥ । abdataḥ vatsarāt bhavediti śeṣaḥ । gurutāṃ ghanatām । śakramatibhābalatāptidāṃ śakrasya bhūrbuddhitejobalabhānāmāptidām । guṇavatsaratastrivatsarāt । vajrakāyo vajravaddṛḍhakāyaḥ । dharādhipo vasudhādhipaḥ । ravisaṅko vaiḥ dvādaśavarṣaiḥ । śatakratutulyaḥ । indrasamānaḥ । tadadha uddhārakrame tasya lakārasyādhobhūtaṃ padamityanvayaḥ । kṣatrenābhau । himānī śālimadhyagaṃ himānī himasaṃhatiḥ tasyāmīśaścandraḥ । tasyālaṃ maṇḍalam । tadgataṃ candramaṇḍalamadhyagatamityarthaḥ । padaṃ pakāram । gadorogaḥ । ravito dvādaśābdāt । vidhau candraloke । śambhuvasumannaveśāṣṭamam । svādhāle svādhiṣṭhānamaṇḍale । sarudraṃ sabindukam । uktakālataḥ pūrvasūtroktakālakrameṇa । dhanañjayapure agniloke । dvājinavātmasaptamaṃ pradhānaprathamam । naveśaprathamam । śuddhau viśuddhau । ravihāyanaṃ dvādaśavarṣam । bihvi bile । ājñāsthāne । śambhuyugmaṃ naveśadvitayam । uditārkaraktavarṇamakāragaṃ bindugam । parāpure śaktipure । nāve vaibhavapade । vibhuṃ caturthakam । vibhuścaturthakaḥ । tenaiva turyeṇaiva bhūṣitam । alaṅkṛtam । binduśiraskamityarthaḥ । tattṛtīyaṃ naveśatṛtīyam ।
(p.162) sadāvāse kodaṇḍamadhye । rudro binduḥ । sarvabhuvaneśapatitāṃ sarvajño bhūtvā bhuvanānāṃ tadīśānāñca patitvam । satyataḥ satyam । medasi svādhiṣṭhāne । arkanibhāṃ raktavarṇām । kṛtiṃ prakṛtim । tannavamīṃ naveśasya navamīm । ardhacandrabindunādadhyānamāha - kārmuketi । kārmukabimbatra * * * * stakośakārasya śakāraḥ ṣaḍaśrake pārijātakuśarūpābhāse kuśabdaḥ kuśaikadeśaḥ । pa śabdaḥ puṣpaikadeśaḥ । tena * * * * * * * puṣpābhāse śuklavarṇa ityarthaḥ । maṇḍalānyardhacandrabindunādalakṣaṇāni । tadantaragatāṃ maṇḍalatrayāntaragatām । vibhvīṃ mahāvibhūtimatīm । kuṇḍalīṃ naveśotthāpitām । kuṇḍalinīṃ śaktim । randhravāsagāṃ brahmarandhrasthānagām । śuklārkaraktamaṇḍalamūrdhasthām । śuklopalakṣitārdhacandrārkopavītabinduraktopalakṣitanādamaṇḍalatrayamūrdhasthām । indupānīṃ punarindūpalakṣitāṃ pānarūpāmṛtadhārāvāhinīṃ dhyāyediti śeṣaḥ । ṛtau māsadvaya(dhyāne) evamuktaprakāreṇa na skhalitavācikām । skhalitaśabdena vyapagatamātraṃ kāryam lakṣyate । manaśśabdenāpādānamanaśvyapana mātreṇa samīhitārthavācikāmityarthaḥ । uktañca -
"yaddhi manasā dhyāyati tadvā{cā} vada"ti । "manaḥ pūrvovāguttara" iti ca । sarvetyādi । sarvaśabdaśśāstrādiṣu caturṣu sambadhyate । āgamāmnāyaśabdotraiva varṇitaḥ । sarvādhikāgamaviṣayaḥ । śive idamāntritaṃ śambhorguṇabhāgī । sarvajñatvādidharmaniṣṭhaṃ śrīvaibhavaṃ śrīśambhusambandhīti śivam ।। (p.163)
